name: fde-academy-backend
description: FDE Academy backend v2 — standalone Node.js + PostgreSQL service: auth, RBAC, catalog, secure book downloads, server-scored assessments, adaptive learning engine, knowledge-check feedback, grounded AI tutor, CMS + admin console, analytics.

comments.dependencies: Zero runtime dependencies by design: Node stdlib (http, crypto, fs) covers routing, scrypt password hashing and HS256 tokens. Production PostgreSQL uses the optional 'pg' driver; tests run on @electric-sql/pglite (real PostgreSQL compiled to WASM) so migrations and queries are verified against genuine PostgreSQL semantics.
